data.one_liner: Tab switcher with live thumbnails in a grid, zoom transitions, and drag-and-drop reordering.
data.what_it_does: Provides a tab switcher where tabs are displayed as live thumbnails in a grid. Tapping a thumbnail zooms it into a full page with a hero animation, while dragging allows reordering and swiping closes tabs.
use_when: You need a browser-style or multi-document tab overview interface with live thumbnail cards.
Users need to open, close, reorder, and switch between multiple active application pages.
avoid_when: You just need a standard row or bottom navigation bar like Flutter's built-in TabBar.
Your app does not benefit from an overview grid of active screens.
strengths: Supports live thumbnails that zoom seamlessly into full pages.
Includes drag-and-drop reordering and swipe-to-close out of the box.
Highly customizable animations, spring physics, decorations, and gestures.
weaknesses: Niche UI pattern that may not fit standard mobile navigation paradigms.
Requires managing a custom tab controller and custom models.
